description: Add a qualified labor pool, or edit one, as the labor resources screen does: its name and the workers qualified in it (at most 100). Plans draw crews from pools. Omit pool to add one (name required); name an existing pool by id or name (get_labor_resources) to rename it or change its members. Pass workers for the complete member list, or addWorkers and removeWorkers to adjust the current one; workers by id or full name. Archived workers can't be added. Admin; operator credentials only. Preview first; the in-app assistant gets a confirm card.

addWorkers.description: Workers to add to the current members, by id or full name.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

name.description: The pool's name, at most 120 characters; required for a new pool.

pool.description: The pool to edit, by id or name; omit to add a new pool.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

removeWorkers.description: Workers to remove from the current members, by id or full name.

workers.description: The complete list of qualified workers, by id or full name.

name: save_labor_pool
title: Save Labor Pool
